info.name: Multi-Agent GitHub Code Review & Auto-Fix System
info.description:
Complete Postman collection for the Multi-Agent GitHub Code Review & Auto-Fix System.

**Base URL:** http://localhost:8081

**6-Agent Pipeline:**
1. Reader — clones repo, maps files
2. Analyser (GPT-4o) — finds security & quality issues
3. Critic (GPT-4o) — adversarially eliminates false positives
4. Fixer (GPT-4o) — generates code patches
5. PR Raiser — creates GitHub branch + pull request
6. Notifier — persists findings to PostgreSQL + sends email

**How to use:**
1. Set the `baseUrl` collection variable (default: http://localhost:8081)
2. Trigger a review via `POST /api/review/trigger`
3. Copy the returned `runId` into the `runId` collection variable
4. Poll `GET /api/review/status/{runId}` or watch Temporal UI at http://localhost:8080
5. Query results via GraphQL at /graphiql

variable.description: Base URL of the running application

item.name: 1. Health & Status
item.description: Verify the application is up and all dependencies are healthy before triggering a review.

request.description:
Spring Boot Actuator health endpoint. Returns UP when all components (DB, Temporal) are healthy.

**Expected response:**
```json
{ "status": "UP" }
```

If status is DOWN, check:
- PostgreSQL: `docker compose ps postgres`
- Temporal: `docker compose ps temporal`
- App logs: `docker compose logs -f app`
Kubernetes-style liveness probe — only checks if the JVM process is alive, not dependencies.
Lists all available Spring Boot Actuator endpoints.
Returns application info (name, version, description) from build.gradle.

Triggers the 6-agent code review pipeline on the auth-service-jwt repository.

item.name: 3. Poll Pipeline Status
item.description: Check the status of a pipeline run. Poll until status is COMPLETED or FAILED.

item.name: Get Run Status — By Variable runId

request.description:
Gets the current status of a pipeline run using the `runId` collection variable.

**Status values:**
- `PENDING` — workflow queued, not yet started
- `RUNNING` — pipeline executing (Reader → Analyser → Critic → Fixer → PR → Notifier)
- `COMPLETED` — all agents finished, PR raised, findings saved
- `FAILED` — unrecoverable error (check `errorMessage` field)

**Polling strategy:** Poll every 30 seconds. Total duration ~5-8 minutes.

**Better alternative:** Watch progress live at Temporal UI → http://localhost:8080

item.name: 4. GitHub Webhook
item.description: Simulate GitHub push events that automatically trigger a code review. The webhook payload must be signed with HMAC-SHA256.

request.description:
Simulates a GitHub push webhook event.

**⚠️ IMPORTANT:** The `X-Hub-Signature-256` header must be a valid HMAC-SHA256 signature of the request body using your `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET`.

**How to generate the signature (bash):**
```bash
SECRET="your_webhook_secret_here"
BODY='{"ref":"refs/heads/main",...}'
echo -n "$BODY" | openssl dgst -sha256 -hmac "$SECRET"
```

**How to generate the signature (PowerShell):**
```powershell
$secret = "your_webhook_secret_here"
$body = Get-Content -Raw payload.json
$hmac = [System.Security.Cryptography.HMACSHA256]::new([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($secret))
$hash = $hmac.ComputeHash([Text.Encoding]::UTF8.GetBytes($body))
"sha256=" + [BitConverter]::ToString($hash).Replace("-","").ToLower()
```

**GitHub webhook configuration:**
- Payload URL: `http://your-server:8081/api/webhook/github`
- Content type: `application/json`
- Secret: value of `GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET` in your `.env`
- Events: Just the push event

response.name: 401 Unauthorized — Invalid Signature
response.body:
{
  "type": "https://problems.codereview.ai/unauthorized",
  "title": "Webhook Signature Invalid",
  "status": 401,
  "detail": "HMAC-SHA256 signature mismatch — verify GITHUB_WEBHOOK_SECRET matches your GitHub webhook configuration",
  "instance": "/api/webhook/github"
}

request.description: Non-push events (pull_request, issues, etc.) are received but do not trigger a review. The system only acts on `push` events to avoid infinite loops from AI-raised PRs.

item.name: 5. GraphQL API
item.description: Query pipeline results via GraphQL. Open the interactive explorer at http://localhost:8081/graphiql

body.raw:
{
  "query": "query AllRuns {
  allRuns {
    id
    repoUrl
    branch
    status
    triggerType
    totalIssuesFound
    totalIssuesFixed
    totalFalsePositives
    prUrl
    prBranch
    errorMessage
    startedAt
    completedAt
  }
}"

request.description:
Retrieves all pipeline runs from the database. Returns newest first.

For the interactive GraphiQL editor, open: http://localhost:8081/graphiql

body.raw:
{
  "query": "query AllRunsWithFindings {
  allRuns {
    id
    repoUrl
    status
    totalIssuesFound
    totalIssuesFixed
    totalFalsePositives
    prUrl
    startedAt
    completedAt
    findings {
      id
      filePath
      lineNumber
      issueType
      severity
      confidence
      status
      description
      originalCode
      fixedCode
      commitMessage
      criticReasoning
      createdAt
    }
  }
}"

request.description: Retrieves all runs with their complete findings. This is the richest query — includes Critic reasoning for every finding.

response.name: 200 — With Findings

request.description:
Fetch a specific pipeline run by UUID using GraphQL variables.

The `{{runId}}` collection variable is automatically populated when you trigger a review using the test script.

Fetch all runs with findings. Filter client-side for status == 'FIXED' to see only applied patches.

Note: Server-side filtering by finding status can be added via a `findingsByStatus` query if needed.

body.raw:
{
  "query": "{ __schema { types { name kind description fields { name type { name kind } } } } }"

request.description:
Full GraphQL schema introspection — returns all types, fields, and their descriptions.

Useful for discovering the exact field names when building queries.

body.raw:
{
  "query": "{ __type(name: \"Query\") { name fields { name description args { name type { name kind ofType { name } } } type { name kind ofType { name kind } } } } }"

request.description: Introspect just the Query type to see available query operations and their arguments.
Lightweight summary query — no findings subfields. Use for dashboards or listing all runs.

item.name: 6. Observability
item.description: Access observability UIs and monitoring endpoints.

request.description:
Opens the self-hosted GraphiQL UI.

**Note:** Open this in a browser, not in Postman.

URL: http://localhost:8081/graphiql

Features:
- Pre-loaded with AllRuns query example
- Schema explorer (Docs panel on the right)
- Local assets — no CDN dependency
- Dark-themed with system branding

Temporal workflow visibility UI.

**Open in browser:** http://localhost:8080

Shows:
- All workflow executions (running + completed + failed)
- Activity timeline for each workflow
- Input/output of each activity
- Retry history
- Full workflow event history (replay log)
Current JVM heap memory usage in bytes.
Total HTTP requests served, tagged by method, status, and URI.

request.description: Missing required `repoUrl` field — returns RFC 7807 ProblemDetail with field-level error detail.
Malformed JSON body returns RFC 7807 ProblemDetail with parse error details.
Invalid HMAC-SHA256 signature on webhook request is rejected with 401 Unauthorized.
DELETE is not supported on the trigger endpoint — returns 405 Method Not Allowed.
GraphQL returns a structured error when querying a field that does not exist in the schema.
